audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Skill/Lucian/Skill/Lucian against a 25% win rate, while the whys on the same page say he wins the attrition war from 4 onward and 'out-scales you completely'.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror (audits/top/singed__lucian.json) settled this chart as Lucian / Lucian / Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Singed, which is also exactly the packet chart. Restated from this side it is identical.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-6 flipped in both layers; difficulty prose and ratings brought in line with 25%.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly owned: Lvl 2-3 Lucian window, Lvl 6 proxy, 1st item Rylai's/Liandry's, Late flip-and-run. Only the ability slot letters inside them were wrong (see point 4).

audit.whatIsWrong: Content calls Fling his W in eight places ('his W fling', 'flips you into your own tower with W'). Fling is his E — 125 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. His W is Mega Adhesive, the goo.
audit.why: Riot text: E 'Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed'; W 'Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies'. Telling a Lucian to watch the wrong slot is fatal here because the two buttons demand opposite responses — you dodge Fling by not being within 125 units, and you answer Mega Adhesive by not walking into a puddle.
audit.corrected: All slot letters fixed and Fling's 125 range given.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mega Adhesive grounds, and grounding stops Relentless Pursuit from casting at all. Nothing on this page said so.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive carries the grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes') and Relentless Pursuit is a dash. Standing in the goo you do not have an escape button — you have a walk. The mirror recorded the same interaction from Singed's side: goo on him, not ahead of him, then Fling him back into the puddle where the landing roots him. It is the decisive interaction in the matchup and it belongs on both pages.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, phases[3].why and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot text: 'making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds'. Once R is up, every tick of trail cuts your healing, so Doran's Blade lifesteal and any Legend: Bloodline value collapses inside his poison. Flagged as an applicable missing interaction for this exact matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.difficulty said 'Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10' while diff is HARD and the win rate is 25%.
audit.why: The mirror rated it 5/10 favoured from Singed's side; inverted, this is a hard lane for Lucian, not an even one.
audit.corrected: Set to 'Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10', diffRating and carryRating raised to match.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are the only part of this lane you own, so make them count. Singed is one of the worst level-1s in the game and his W fling has a real cooldown early, so chunk him with Q poke and your Lightslinger double-shots before he sticks his poison trail on you. The hard rule: never auto-attack him while standing in his green poison trail, and respect the W fling range — if he flings you backward into the trail or toward his tower, that single CC eats your low base HP before E is even worth burning.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are the only part of this lane you own, so make them count. Singed is one of the worst level-1s in the game and Fling (E) is 10s at rank 1, so chunk him with Q poke and Lightslinger double-shots before Poison Trail sticks to you. The hard rule: never auto-attack him while standing in the green trail, and respect Fling's 125 range — he has to touch you to use it, and if he flips you toward his tower that single knockup eats your HP bar before E is worth burning.

edits.before: From 4 onward this slips away fast. Singed gets sustain, his poison trail covers the whole lane, and his base move speed plus Rush makes him impossible to pin with W's mark or kite with your E dash — he just walks through it. At 6 he stops fighting you entirely and proxies behind your wave, farming on move speed where The Culling has no clean line to hit him. Your R wants a stationary target; Singed is never stationary, so it routinely whiffs or only clips him.
edits.after: From 4 onward this slips away fast. Singed gets sustain, Poison Trail covers the whole lane, and Mega Adhesive is the button that ends you: it grounds, so inside the goo Relentless Pursuit does not cast and Fling drops you right back into it. At 6 he stops fighting you and proxies behind your wave on Noxious Slipstream speed, where The Culling has no clean line. Your R wants a stationary target and Singed is never stationary, so it whiffs or clips him.

edits.before: This is lost and you have to be honest about it: Singed out-scales you hard. Rylai's plus his W fling means one flick puts you in his poison and you're dead before you dash out, and your squishy ADC frame has no answer to percent-HP poison ticking on permanent move speed. Don't try to 1v1 him or chase his splitpush — you'll get flung into your own tower. Group, take your value from your early-game lead if you got one, and let your team peel the unkiteable drain-tank you can't catch.
edits.after: This is lost and you have to be honest about it: Singed out-scales you hard. Rylai's plus Fling (E) means one flick puts you in the poison, and with Insanity Potion up that poison also cuts your healing in half while you try to leave. Don't 1v1 him or chase his splitpush — goo grounds your dash and you get flung into your own tower. Group, cash whatever early lead you banked, and let your team peel the drain-tank you cannot catch.

notes: suspectNames flagged "The Culling's" in wants.foe[1] — false positive, that is the correct Riot name in possessive form. Left alone. The mirror noted a separate typo, 'he simply Relentless Pursuits the moment you close range', in Singed's own early field; that is on their page, not this one, so nothing to do here.
